_about: One entry per athletic photo. caption = training caption (trigger word is added in front automatically; never mention hair, eyes or body shape). pose/outfit go into the body-edit prompt. shows = body parts visible in the shot (chest, waist, hips, butt, legs, arms); a body type only edits photos that show a part it changes, the rest are copied unchanged.
